title: Google Ads for Window Companies | Netembark

facts.fact: Netembark states it holds the Google Premier Partner 2023 badge.
Netembark states its service terms are month-to-month.
Netembark's own page shows a 4.9 Google rating.
Netembark claims to have managed more than $40M in Google Ads spend.
Netembark states it has been in business for 18 years.
Netembark states it has worked with more than 1,000 customers.
Netembark claims more than 1 million conversions across its managed accounts.
Netembark claims up to 6x ROAS, but the page says this is the best result in an e-commerce Google Ads account and results vary by account.
facts.quote: Best result in an e-commerce Google Ads account; results vary by account.

facts.fact: Netembark states it has operated since 2009.
Netembark claims to be a Fortune 5000 Company.
Netembark claims to be in the top 1% of digital marketing agencies.
Netembark displays an Expertise.com 'Best Advertising Agencies in Newark' badge, a third-party listing.
facts.quote: Expertise.com Best Advertising Agencies in Newark

facts.fact: Google says uploads of offline conversion data move to the Data Manager API starting June 15, 2026, per the page.
facts.quote: Google says uploads move to the Data Manager API starting June 15, 2026

facts.fact: Netembark states it imports booked estimates and won jobs into Google Ads as offline conversions.
facts.quote: Netembark imports booked estimates and won jobs into Google Ads as offline conversions
